production.note: Calendar years, Japan. Nissan: "ATTESA E-TS PRO was adopted as the drive system for the all-new R33 GT-R rolled out in January 1995." The Gulliver catalog (database) lists the plain GT-R V-Spec grade in three periods: "1995年1月〜1996年1月" (goo-bcnr33-vspec-1995), "1996年1月〜1997年2月" (goo-bcnr33-vspec-1996) and "平成9年2月〜平成11年1月（1997年2月〜1999年1月）" (goo-bcnr33-vspec-1997), the last ending when the R34 replaced it. 1998 is inferred as the last build year; no page states it. Evo gives "On sale 1995-1997" (UK sales).

drivetrain.note: ATTESA E-TS PRO electronically controlled four-wheel drive (catalog: "FULL4WD").

powerHp.note: Nissan's 280 PS (206 kW) at 6,800 rpm x 0.98632 = 276 hp. Quote (Nissan Heritage Collection): "Engine Max. power 206kW(280ps)/6,800rpm". Evo panel: "276bhp @ 6800rpm".

weightLb.note: Nissan curb weight, 1997 car: 1,540 kg x 2.20462 = 3,395 lb. Quote: "Curb weight 1,540kg". Evo's panel and all three Gulliver catalog entries for the V-Spec (1995, 1996, 1997 periods; goo-bcnr33-vspec-1995, goo-bcnr33-vspec-1996, goo-bcnr33-vspec-1997) give the same 1,540 kg.
